title: FIX: Accept finding_counts when listing operations

files.patch:
@@ -278,7 +278,11 @@ async def list_operations_async(self) -> list[Operation]:
         from pyrit.models import Operation
 
         payload = await self._get_json_async(path="/api/operations")
-        return [Operation.model_validate(item) for item in payload["items"]]
+        # The list endpoint returns OperationListItem records, which add ``finding_counts`` to Operation.
+        return [
+            Operation.model_validate({key: value for key, value in item.items() if key != "finding_counts"})
+            for item in payload["items"]
+        ]
 
     async def list_datasets_async(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
         """

@@ -55,6 +55,20 @@ def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
     assert rows == [operation]
 
 
+async def test_list_operations_accepts_finding_counts_from_list_items_async() -> None:
+    operation = Operation(name="Saved")
+
+    def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
+        item = {**operation.model_dump(mode="json"), "finding_counts": {"high": 2}}
+        return httpx.Response(200, json={"items": [item]})
+
+    client = PyRITApiClient(base_url="http://localhost:8000")
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler), base_url="http://localhost:8000") as transport:
+        client._client = transport
+        rows = await client.list_operations_async()
+    assert rows == [operation]
+
+
